name: read_financial_records
description: Read owned loans, mutual funds, stocks, commitments, credit cards, savings or account labels. Use records view to discover IDs and history view with an ID for recorded payment/allocation history. No writes or live market valuation; holdings are not cash. Search matches names literally, case-insensitively. Page through nextOffset; do not treat a limited page as the whole portfolio. For monthly totals and salary comparison use read_monthly_plan, not sums of these records.

id.description: Optional owned record ID; required for history. Savings uses plan ID.
